list.text: \f[faceprofbirch]\bSo \PN...\nYou brought it with you.\nThe Mysterious Ball.
\PN handed the Mysterious Ball to Professor Birch!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bI'll start analyzing it right away.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bI’ve seen a lot of unusual Pokémon behavior out here.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bSpikes in energy. Patterns that repeat.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bThis Mysterious Ball is responding to the same phenomenon my team’s been tracking.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bPokémon trained outside Hoenn aren't adapting well to this environment.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bSo until we understand this better, I need you working with a Pokémon that’s fully attuned to Hoenn.
All your Pokémon were deposited.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bThese three were raised right here.\nThey’re used to Hoenn’s climate, terrain, and energy.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bChoose one.\nIt’ll be your partner while we continue investigating the Mysterious Ball.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bWhich one do you want?

branches.text: Do you really want Torchic, the Fire-type Pokémon?
Do you really want Treecko, the Grass-type Pokémon?
Do you really want Mudkip, the Water-type Pokémon?

list.text: \f[faceprofbirch]\bNow you can properly start your journey in Hoenn!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bI bet you can't wait to start challenging the Gym Leaders from here!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bSeveral good Trainers have already started their journey here.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bThe last person from here to win the Hoenn League was Brendan.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bHe is know travelling in some far away regions...\nJust like you!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bOh! You’re back already!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bHm? And who’s this?

then.text: \f[faceprofbirch]\b…Hoho! Don’t tell me you already brought your boyfriend to meet the professor!\nYou trainers grow up fast!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bNow, what seems to be the trouble?
\f[face_namo_boy]\bS-sorry, Professor...\nMy Pokémon… they aren’t listening here. They’ve been acting strange since I arrived in Hoenn.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bHoenn can feel pretty different if you came from another region.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bAnd the Hoenn rules don’t make it any easier for new trainers, either.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bAll right! If you’re going to travel in Hoenn, you’ll need a Hoenn Pokémon.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bOh no! That’s a very special Ball. It was brought here for research.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bWh-what?! That Ball…! It’s reacting to you!
\f[face_namo_boy]\bI’ve been having these dreams lately.\nAnd it sounded exactly like that!
\f[face_namo_boy]\bCan I hold it?\nJust for a second!
\f[face_namo_boy]\bI... I thought it was a starter, but... it wants to stay.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bIf it’s responding to you, forcing it away could be risky...
\f[faceprofbirch]\bAll right! You can carry it under one condition.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bFor safety... and because this Ball has chosen you as its link.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bYes. Hoenn can be kind, but it can also be... dangerous.
Prof. Birch handed the Mysterious Ball to \v[77]
\f[faceprofbirch]\bActually, you’re in luck! There’s one left!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bIt's a Mudkip, an adorable water type Pokémon.
\f[faceprofbirch]\bIt's a Torchic, an adorable fire type Pokémon.

\f[faceprofbirch]\bTell me right away if anything changes!
\f[faceprofbirch]\bAll right then! Your Hoenn adventure is about to begin!

Prof. Birch is studying the habitats and distribution of Pokémon.
The Prof. enjoys May's help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.
\f[facemay]\r\PN! My Dad forgot to share his phone number!
\f[facemay]\rWe'll give you a call if we have any news about the Mysterious Ball.
\f[facemay]\rAnd one more thing...
\f[facemay]\rWhile you're in Hoenn, can you do some fieldwork for us?
\f[facemay]\rPlease register as many Pokémon as you can in the Pokédex.\nThis will help us to figure out why some Pokémon don't adapt well in Hoenn.
\f[facemay]\rLet me upgrade your Pokédex with the Hoenn mode.
